rationale.selected_because: The current objective is to review the reported lock-work completion without treating a contractor’s statement as verified completion. Most recently, Edrin again said the work was complete, but the file still lacks visit details or attendance evidence; an invoice remains promised. Request work details, put the case into completion review, and wait for the promised invoice. Keep the tenant and landlord informed without claiming the work is verified.
